sermon.title: Violators Refuse to Repent 01/06/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that repentance is a commandment, yet many refuse to repent even under God’s wrath and miracles. Tax collectors, Zacchaeus and Rahab repented and were transformed, while religious leaders did not. He warns the church about Jezebel and sin at the Lord’s table, and asks whether a Nineveh-like season could come before Christ returns.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: So the people of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest to the least of them.
Those who are wise shall shine Like the brightness of the firmament, And those who turn many to righteousness Like the stars forever and ever.

After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could number, of all nations, tribes, peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palm branches in their hands,

faqs.question: What kinds of witchcraft does he name?
faqs.answer: Witchcraft of the flesh and of drugs.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But one thing is needed, and Mary has chosen that good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

faqs.question: Why does God’s presence come?
faqs.answer: Not to make you feel good but to open your eyes.

faqs.question: What does he say about the church in America?
faqs.answer: He calls it unsafe, citing priest abuse in the news.

faqs.question: What does he say about “nothing can separate you”?
faqs.answer: He disputes that sinning believers stay saved.

faqs.question: Must God snatch us out before He comes?
faqs.answer: He says God can keep us right here.

faqs.question: Does grace have a doctrine?
faqs.answer: Yes, how to behave in the house of God.

faqs.question: Is music the main thing in church?
faqs.answer: No; God’s presence and word are.
